# Delete all spam text messages from 5708520672
text_delete_results=[]
for tid in filtered_text_message_ids:
    print('deleting_text', tid)
    r=apis.phone.delete_text_message(text_message_id=tid, access_token=phone_token)
    print('result', r)
    text_delete_results.append((tid,r))

# Delete all spam voice messages from 5708520672
